class L(list): pass
a=L((7,9))
b=a
a.append(11)
a[0]=13
del a[1]
print(a is b,len(b),b[0],b[1],type(a[:]) is list,type(a+[17]) is list)

class L(list): pass
a=L((7,9))
b=a
a+=[11]
a*=2
print(a is b,len(b),b[3],type(a) is L)

class L(list):
 def append(self,value): print("override"); return 7
 def __setitem__(self,key,value): print("set"); return None
a=L((7,))
print(a.append(9))
list.append(a,11)
a[0]=13
list.__setitem__(a,0,17)
print(a[0],len(a))

class L(list): pass
a=L((7,9))
b=a
print(list.__init__(a,(11,)),a is b,len(b),b[0])

class L(list): pass
a=L((7,9))
def items():
 print("before",len(a))
 yield 11
 print("after",len(a),a[0])
 yield 13
list.__init__(a,items())
print(len(a),a[1])

class L(list): pass
a=L((7,9))
it=iter(a)
print(next(it))
a.append(11)
print(next(it),next(it))

class L(list): pass

print(a[0] is x,list(a)[0] is x,(a*2)[1] is x)

class D(dict): pass
d=D()
d[7]=9
d[11]=13
b=d
print(d[7],len(d),7 in d,next(iter(d)),d=={7:9,11:13})
del d[7]
print(len(b),7 in b,d is b)

class D(dict):
 def __getitem__(self,key): print("get"); return 11
 def __setitem__(self,key,value): print("set")

d[7]=9
dict.__setitem__(d,7,13)
print(d[7],dict.__getitem__(d,7),dict.__contains__(d,7))

s.add(11)
s.discard(7)

class S(set):
 def add(self,key): print("add")
 def __contains__(self,key): return False
s=S((7,))
s.add(9)
set.add(s,11)
print(7 in s,set.__contains__(s,7),set.__contains__(s,11),len(s))

s=S((7,9))
it=iter(s)
s.add(11)
next(it)

class B(bytearray): pass

c=b
b[0]=90
print(c is b,c[0],len(c),type(b[:]) is bytearray,type(b+b"c") is bytearray)

class B(bytearray):
 def __getitem__(self,key): return 7
 def __setitem__(self,key,value): print("set")
b=B(b"ab")
b[0]=90
bytearray.__setitem__(b,0,89)
print(b[0],bytearray.__getitem__(b,0))

class B(bytearray): pass
b=B(b"abcd")
v=memoryview(b)
w=v[::2].toreadonly()
print(v.obj is b,w.obj is b,w.tobytes()==b"ac")
v[0]=90
print(b[0],w[0])
v.release()
w.release()

class B(bytearray): pass

v=memoryview(b)
try: bytearray.__init__(b,b"ab")
except BufferError: print(b[0],len(b),v.obj is b)
v.release()
bytearray.__init__(b,b"xyz")
print(len(b),b[0])
